notes.title: Auto-Combat, Optimizations & More! Demo Build v.18648855
notes.content:
Good day, brave knights!

We've been collecting your feedback since the launch of the demo and have been working on improving not only the demo itself, but the final game too.

We've very thankful to everyone that took the time to leave a review and share their comments with us on the [url=https://roundtablegame.com/discord]Discord server[/url].

Here are the main improvements we've made:

[h1]Auto-Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] We've designed an auto-combat system that allows players to delegate tactical decisions to their lieutenants and quickly resolve combats during the Great Battles.
Auto-combat can't be used in combats with Arthur, or when you're attacking the enemy general.
[/list]

[h1]User Interface (UI) improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] We've improved the UI during persuation challenges by improving the visibility of cards and their associated modifiers.
[*] We've also clarified the tooltip for Group Cohesion, better describing its effects.
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Global performance upgrades - we've optimized multiple game systems, helping with game performance accross the board.
[*] Balanced Nero's stats and behavior during combat.
[*] Added swords for characters in the intro and conclusion of the London Tournament adventure.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a saving issue in the Green Knight adventure that was causing the introduction to replay after loading an adventure in progress.
[/list]

Please keep the feedback coming - it's super useful and we're working around the clock to improve the demo and the game thanks to your comments!

notes.title: Demo Now Live & Official Trailer Launch!
notes.content:
Valliant Knights and Ladies,

The wait is finally over! The [b]official trailer[/b] for Legends of the Round Table is here, and the [b]free playable demo[/b] is now live!

[previewyoutube=BjlSHSED8x8;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3013400/?utm_source=News&utm_medium=Steam&utm_campaign=DemoLaunch

[h1]💬 Discord & Feedback[/h1]
We'd LOVE to know what you think of the demo - please join us on our [url=http://roundtablegame.com/discord]Discord server[/url] (http://roundtablegame.com/discord) and share your thoughts with us!

[h1]💚 Wishlist[/h1]
Please remember to wishlist the game (or demo - same thing!) it helps us tremendously. If you have a friend or a community that would love Legends of the Round Table, consider sending them a link to the free demo!

[h1]👑 Arthurian Adventures[/h1]
In Legends of the Round Table, you’ll take charge of King Arthur’s knights and shape the kingdom's fate through legendary quests filled with mystery, danger, and, of course, romance! These aren’t just any adventures, as they are drawn from real Arthurian tales and adapted to bring the folklore to life like never before. Inspired by Thomas Malory, Chrétien de Troyes and other medieval sources, every detail is crafted with care, from hand-painted art in the style of illuminated manuscripts to a soundtrack performed on real medieval instruments. It’s a rich blend of deep RPG storytelling, chivalric combat and love for the setting, and we can’t wait for you to experience it!

tags.feature: The [b]free playable demo[/b] is now live!

notes.title: The Great Battles ⚔
notes.content:
We're really excited to finally shed a little bit of light on one of the mechanics we've been teasing for a while: the Great Battles!

Arthurian legends featured a few terrifying, bloody battles with extremely high stakes. A feeling we're trying to reproduce in the game.

Read our short introduction to the feature on our latest newsletter.

[h1][url=https://mailchi.mp/artificestudio/lotrt-nl17-thegreatbattles]Newsletter #17 - The Great Battles[/url][/h1]
